answer: An operator running many aliases as a result burns for many distinct network origins and accepts the latency of spreading them thin, while each origin still has to clear the atlas quota and the lotus admission check. Submission rate is limited to 3 per autonomous system per minute, so a datacentre cannot pull quota for a whole swarm from one uplink. Because the counters live in the raven ledger, a burst across neighbours is visible at replay instead of hidden. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
